(()=>{PT8.launch({mode:'mp',rally:true,circuit:true,track:14,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]});const T=RACE.T;let cx=0,cz=0;for(let i=0;i<T.N;i++){cx+=T.x[i];cz+=T.z[i]}cx/=T.N;cz/=T.N;const m={};const v=new THREE.Vector3();RACE.scene.traverse(o=>{if(!o.isMesh||!o.geometry)return;o.geometry.computeBoundingSphere();const s=o.geometry.boundingSphere;v.copy(s.center).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld);const d=Math.hypot(v.x-cx,v.z-cz);const k=o.geometry.type+'|'+(o.name||o.parent&&o.parent.name||'')+'|r'+Math.round(s.radius*o.matrixWorld.getMaxScaleOnAxis())+'|d'+Math.round(d/200)*200+'|'+(o.material&&o.material.type)+(o.isInstancedMesh?'|inst'+o.count:'');m[k]=(m[k]||0)+1});return Object.entries(m).filter(e=>/r[0-9]{3,}/.test(e[0])).map(e=>e.join(' x')).join('\n')})()
